_about: 1-Propanol (1) + Acetonitrile (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of 1-propanol, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of 1-propanol, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Jia, P.[Peng], Zhao, Z.[Zongchang], Gao, Q.[Qinglin], Zhang, X.[Xiaodong], Isobaric Vapor-Liquid Equilibrium of the Acetonitrile + 1-Propanol + Ionic Liquids at an Atmospheric Pressure, J. Chem. Eng. Data 64 (2019) 2963-2972
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 3, 4. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0036. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.17 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
